RECORDED FOR L9, NO VERDICT. Full text: org/missions/D9/IRPT/IRPT_BCKEND/deliverables/0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~V/the-serving-roles-granted.result.md blob d20cf4f7c9f44d7956fa24c616ae8acb71989b2b @b51faa63ac, section R67-AC2.
1. DESIGN. The packet declares the object-scoped read (one object per client firm, GetObject only, registry-derived). It keeps one writer and one location, keeps the rest of platinum/ unreadable, and uses the object key as the fence on the shared opal-data-bd. It costs S94: without ListBucket an absent map reads AccessDenied, and _authz/loaders.py:106-114 @4ceb7f8361 re-raises it, so the design is complete only if the producer publishes a map for every client firm. The publisher-move alternative would make the map readable to every directory-reading role, including irpt-holdings-role whose design grants nothing (holdings/entry.py:17-25 @4ceb7f8361), and would duplicate an entitlement artifact. The CTO's ruling is not yet issued at this pass (halves absent), so there is no difference to state.
2. WHY EARLIER PROOFS PASSED. rtf-2 arm (e) and rtf-8 arm (e) drove the real served.Entry/enforcer_for IN-PROCESS under operator credentials and the harness's own environment: the real code with the wrong identity and the wrong configuration. The instrument rule: a served-path proof runs UNDER THE DEPLOYED ROLE WITH THE DEPLOYED CONFIGURATION (the real HTTP path with a bounded principal, or at minimum aws lambda invoke of the deployed function), carries a pre-grant negative control under the same role (S90's 12 of 12 UNEXPECTED @e7da534cc6), and an in-process run is labelled a MECHANISM test.
3. S91. _authz/served.py:628,649,662 @4ceb7f8361 record every internal error to a None sink; with no monitor by design, only a live authenticated request could surface S90. S93, S94 and S95 were found by measuring the deployed plane, never in-process.
